亡者の気配がしないとは……不思議な場所だね。

It's strange not to see any signs of the risen dead
here in the heart of Dagsion.

世界そのものから隔絶されたような……

is outside the world...

ここは吾が“方尖塔の間”と名付けた、
特別な空間じゃ。
text.official_en: 'Tis a special place. I call it the Obelisk Chamber.

フォトナ神殿の地下にあり、この部屋の
存在を知るものはほとんどおらぬ。
text.official_en:
Only a few people know this chamber exists beneath
my temple.

「彼女」が吾に用意させていたものじゃ。

It was she who asked me to prepare it, in case
disaster ever struck this land.

ある程度の未来を知る力を持っておる。
text.official_en:
Since I am the Goddess of Fate, I enjoy the power to
glimpse into the future.

因果の乱れがあることを感じ取ったのじゃ。
text.official_en:
And one of my visions showed me a terrible
disturbance in the causality of this land.

恐ろしいもののように思われた。故に――
text.official_en:
One so awful that it could destroy the world if
left unchecked.

強力な力を持った戦士を探していたのじゃ。
text.official_en:
Since then, I have been searching for powerful
warriors to gather together at this moment in time.

text.official_en:
In the roiling waters of causality, I have found
warriors fit to the task.

Each possesses staggering power and a noble soul.
Any one of them is worth a thousand.

We'll never win the battles ahead without them.
We need as many as we can recruit.
